title: Pure Pursuit
text: Linear and angular velocity control commands, 4 inputs, 3 outputs; {Specify desired linear velocity from input port} enables input port for desired linear, {Desired linear velocity (m/s)} sets the linear velocity, {Maximum angular velocity (rad/s)} sets the angular velocity, {Specify lookahead distance from input port} enables input port for look-ahead distances, {Lookahead distance (m)} sets the look-ahead distance, {Show Target Direction output port} sets the target direction indicator and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run. Values come from the instance.
